speaker: patient
text: Jeg har vondt i magen.
reference: I have pain in my stomach.
note: mage may be stomach or abdomen

speaker: patient
text: Smerten er sju av ti.
reference: The pain is seven out of ten.

speaker: patient
text: Smerten sitter i høyre side av brystet.
reference: The pain is in the right side of my chest.

speaker: patient
text: Smerten startet i går kveld.
reference: The pain started yesterday evening.

speaker: patient
text: Jeg trenger hjelp til å gå på toalettet.
reference: I need help to go to the toilet.

speaker: patient
text: Kan jeg få litt vann?
reference: Can I have some water?

speaker: patient
text: æ har så vondt i magen
reference: I have so much pain in my stomach.
note: Dialect spelling: æ = jeg. vondt is uncertain (sore vs pain).

speaker: patient
text: får itj sove
reference: [uncertain] I cannot sleep.
note: itj = ikke (dialect). Confirm meaning with patient.

speaker: patient
text: Æ e veldig kvalm.
reference: [uncertain] I feel very nauseous.
note: kvalm is uncertain; confirm nausea vs sickness.

speaker: patient
text: vondt… her
reference: [should ask for clarification]
note: Incomplete. Ask where and how bad.

speaker: patient
text: pillen?
reference: [should ask for clarification]
note: Incomplete. Unclear if asking about a pill, its timing or asking for one.

speaker: patient
text: Sykepleier!
reference: Nurse!

speaker: patient
text: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
reference: Jeg blir svimmel når jeg reiser meg.

speaker: patient
text: I am NOT allergic to penicillin.
reference: Jeg er IKKE allergisk mot penicillin.

speaker: patient
text: I have had a fever since Tuesday.
reference: Jeg har hatt feber siden tirsdag.

speaker: patient
text: Jeg tok to tabletter klokken seks i morges.
reference: I took two tablets at six this morning.

speaker: patient
text: Smerten er brennende og stikkende i venstre legg.
reference: The pain is burning and stabbing in my left leg.

speaker: patient
text: Det dunker i hodet, og det er verst om morgenen.
reference: My head is throbbing, and it is worst in the morning.

speaker: worker
text: Did you take your blood thinner this morning?
reference: Tok du blodfortynnende medisin i morges?

speaker: worker
text: Do you agree that we take a blood sample?
reference: Godtar du at vi tar en blodprøve?

speaker: worker
text: You will get 500 mg paracetamol every six hours.
reference: Du får 500 mg paracetamol hver sjette time.

speaker: worker
text: The doctor comes at 14:30.
reference: Legen kommer klokken 14:30.

speaker: worker
text: Rate your pain from 0 to 10.
reference: Vurder smerten din fra 0 til 10.

speaker: worker
text: Where does it hurt?
reference: Hvor gjør det vondt?

speaker: worker
text: When did the pain start?
reference: Når startet smerten?

speaker: worker
text: Do you consent to the procedure?
reference: Samtykker du til prosedyren?

speaker: worker
text: Please confirm: you are NOT allergic to penicillin, correct?
reference: [uncertain] Bekreft: du er IKKE allergisk mot penicillin, stemmer det?
note: Negation check; confirm phrasing with clinician.

speaker: worker
text: Can you swallow?
reference: Kan du svelge?

speaker: worker
text: Hvor lenge har du hatt vondt?
reference: How long have you had pain?

speaker: worker
text: Du skal ta to tabletter hver åttende time.
reference: You should take two tablets every eight hours.

speaker: worker
text: Legen kommer i morgen tidlig.
reference: The doctor comes early tomorrow morning.

speaker: worker
text: Samtykker du til at vi tar en blodprøve?
reference: Do you consent to us taking a blood sample?

speaker: worker
text: Har du feber i dag?
reference: Do you have a fever today?

speaker: worker
text: Pain score?
reference: Smerteskår?

speaker: worker
text: Your blood pressure is 120 over 80.
reference: [uncertain] Blodtrykket ditt er 120 over 80.
note: Values are fixed; check blodtrykk term.

speaker: worker
text: Are you feeling dizzy when you stand?
reference: [uncertain] Føler du deg svimmel når du reiser deg?
